job.name: s8_asking
job.prompt: Semi-flat illustration. The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) behind the pharmacy counter leans slightly forward and attentively asks a customer a question, one hand open in an inviting gesture; the customer, holding a hand near their throat, is answering and looks relieved to be asked. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
job.meaning: фармацевт задаёт уточняющие вопросы — картина проясняется
